issue:
Feature request: add slugify(text) to textkit and export it from the package (from textkit import slugify).

Rules: lowercase; every run of characters that are not ASCII letters or digits becomes a single '-'; no leading or trailing '-'.

Examples: slugify("Hello, World!") == "hello-world"; slugify("  Multi   Agent__SDK  ") == "multi-agent-sdk"; slugify("") == "".
